name: Big Ben Blocks: Block Puzzle
description:
Fit the blocks. Clear the lines. Beat yesterday.

Big Ben Blocks is a block puzzle with a British accent. Place pieces on a 9x9 grid and complete rows, columns or 3x3 boxes to clear space and build your score. Enjoy untimed Classic play or choose a three-minute Time Attack.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Play the Daily Challenge, which changes at midnight UK time. Reach the crown score, build a streak and follow your progress on the monthly calendar.

TEN LEVELS ACROSS LONDON
Explore Adventure levels from Westminster to Piccadilly. Work towards score, line-clearing and combo goals, and clear obstacles along the way. Each level has a fixed starting board and piece sequence.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Earn coins by playing and use undo, hints, rotate and bomb in Classic and Adventure. Daily Challenge and Time Attack keep those aids switched off. There are no in-app purchases.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Collect achievements, check your stats and try to beat your best score. Your game and progress are saved on your device.

ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS
Blocks carry shape symbols as well as colours. Tap-to-place controls provide an alternative to dragging, and the game includes screen-reader labels and reduced-motion support.

OFFLINE PLAY, NO ADS
Play the game modes offline, with no adverts and no account required. Optional Daily Challenge reminders use your device's notification permission.

Whether you want a quick block puzzle or a longer session chasing combos, there is a board waiting for you.
